_readme: Field definitions for the log_message webhook tool. Build it in the ElevenLabs form view; this file documents what to enter. Replace TODOIST_INBOX_PROJECT_ID with your own Inbox project ID.
name: log_message
description: Call this once, right before ending the call, whenever you have taken a message from a legitimate caller (Step 2). Do not call it for spam or vague callers.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.note: Secret value must be: Bearer <todoist api token>

properties.description: Task title. Format: Call back <caller name> (<company, if any>) — <reason in five words or fewer>

Full message details. Format: Callback: <number written as digits, e.g. 706-555-0142>. Best time: <time or 'not given'>. Message: <what the caller said, one or two sentences>. Taken by {{ASSISTANT_NAME}}.
